kcc_query_text_example: ST marginal cashew cultivator with 2.0 acres dryland orchard in Belthangady taluk, Dakshina Kannada; seeking crop insurance coverage against unseasonal rain and tea mosquito bug infestation under Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) / PMFBY; inquiring about premium rates and notified Insurance Units.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: Rainfed coastal laterite hillside cashew orchard; no energized irrigation equipment

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Belthangady taluk, Dakshina Kannada district

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: Directorate of Cashew Research (Puttur) & AIC of India: Rainfed cashew plantations in Belthangady/Puttur highly vulnerable to weather risks during flowering and fruit-set stages, covered under weather-indexed insurance (RWBCIS).
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Dakshina Kannada crop insurance logs: Tribal marginal cashew growers inquiring about weather-based insurance enrollment cut-off dates and claim triggers.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Cashew crop insurance under RWBCIS; raw engine returns INELIGIBLE (PMFBY_NON_NOTIFIED_CROP) due to static PMFBY crop whitelist; governance decouples determination and routes SCH002 to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION pending seasonal Hobli-level RWBCIS notification; ST marginal dryland qualifies for Valmiki Corporation individual borewell (GK_SCH010_VALMIKI_INDIVIDUAL_ROUTE_VALID, coastal threshold 1.0-5.0 ac), but SCH010_VALMIKI is quarantined in Section B as a provisional scheme; parent SCH010 suppressed; PM-KISAN, SMAM, and KCC Central qualify in Section A.

intended_test_purpose: PMFBY/RWBCIS cashew crop insurance in coastal plantation belt; ST marginal farmer; raw PMFBY INELIGIBLE routed to Section B pending seasonal notification; SCH010_VALMIKI individual route valid but quarantined in Section B; parent SCH010 suppressed; PM-KISAN qualifies in Section A.
